claim: Web Summit Lisbon runs from 9 to 12 November in the MEO Arena and FIL.
Web Summit expects more than 70,000 attendees from more than 100 countries, including 10,000 startups.
Web Summit lists 800 speakers and 17 content tracks over four days.
In 2025, over 22,000 startups applied to Web Summit and about 2,700 were accepted.
The 2025 Web Summit had 71,386 attendees from 157 countries, as reported by Lusa citing the organisers.
Web Summit's first State of the Industry survey was published on 22 October and polled 1,455 people in its community.
55% of survey respondents say AI strengthens their critical thinking, and 26% say it weakens it.
60% of survey respondents say AI has increased their workload, and 20% say it has reduced it.
Web Summit's SVP of Technology Operations, Nidhi Naithani, said people are divided about a future with AI.
